items.title: MuleSoft Anypoint Platform — API Gateway + FedNow Integration + FIS CodeConnect Replacement
items.what_text: FIS CodeConnect is a point-to-point integration between FIS IBS and Salesforce — it is NOT an API gateway. It cannot support multi-system connectivity (FIS → Salesforce → AML → HubSpot → Data Cloud). No FedNow or RTP instant payments. 68% of community bank peers currently offer or plan FedNow in 2025 (CSBS survey, ). Alma Bank's 98.4% LDR means commercial CRE clients are the primary deposit base — losing treasury relationships to FedNow-enabled competitors is an existential deposit risk. MuleSoft Anypoint deployed as the central integration hub: (1) FIS IBS API connector (replacing CodeConnect for FSC data sync), (2) FedNow API integration for commercial clients (real-time treasury payments), (3) AML system → Salesforce Data Cloud connector, (4) HubSpot → Data Cloud migration connector. In Zennify's assessment Enterprise Architecture Strategy scores 1.0 out of 5, versus a typical 2.5 at comparable institutions [E-091].

NYCRR 500 Second Amendment final phase (Nov 1, 2025) requires CEO + CISO dual-signature annual certification with documented evidence of controls. Salesforce Shield's field audit trail, event monitoring, and platform encryption directly produce NYCRR 500-compliant evidence for Salesforce data. BSA case management currently relies on manually built dashboards from the Bessas era — these are now lapsed. SAR triage and CTR filing are manual workflows. SHIELD: Field Audit Trail (records every Salesforce field change for compliance forensics), Event Monitoring (logs all user sessions, API calls for NYCRR 500 evidence), Platform Encryption (encrypts PII at rest in Salesforce — NYCRR 500 data protection requirement). items.title: Salesforce Data Cloud — Customer 360 & Data Silo Unification
items.what_text: Four confirmed data silos at Alma Bank: (1) FIS IBS core banking (transaction history, account balances), (2) HubSpot CRM (marketing, contacts), (3) AML system (risk profiles, SAR history), (4) lapsed Salesforce LOS (loan data). No unified customer object anywhere. Basil Ahmad's Python/Tableau stack is manually reconciling these silos for BSA purposes — an analyst-level solution for an enterprise-scale problem. AWM clients need wealth-level household views (assets, liabilities, referrals) that are impossible without Customer 360. CRE relationship managers cannot see a client's full banking relationship in one system. Data Cloud deployed as the Customer 360 layer unifying FIS IBS + HubSpot + AML system + Salesforce FSC. Ingestion connectors: (1) FIS IBS via MuleSoft (R3), (2) HubSpot native connector, (3) AML system via MuleSoft, (4) FSC natively.
